not_sized: Unsold-room setback via PMS: guest-room FCU/plug load already scales with rooms sold (≈0.2 kW per sold room, ~0 for unsold), so little to gain.

Night base load (00–05 h): audited per sub-meter channel against each channel's own good nights (data/night_baseload.md); only a persistent excess is counted. Cutting below the best nights the meters have seen (switching areas off) needs the night walk-round, not data.
Other capital measures (chiller replacement, solar, heat recovery) are out of scope; pump VFDs are the one capital item, counted only in the with-capital total.

night.method: Each channel vs its own good nights (10th–20th percentile of the 30 most similar nights by occupancy and temperature); claimed only if more than half the nights are above it by more than the ±1 % meter accuracy AND the excess persists from night to night. Alert hours, DG and meter-fault hours, the daily plan's levers and must-run loads are excluded. Original year = the claim; the live (synthetic) year is a check.
